Name: Stardew Chef
Author: StaRzZz91
Description:
Stardew Chef

Turn Stardew Valley cooking into a full chef career with Chef XP, cooking fame, recipe mastery, daily food orders, weekly catering contracts, Gus's Restaurant Night, dish ratings, villager taste preferences, food deliveries, food critic reviews, cooking competitions, recurring rivals, reputation mail, seasonal festival commissions, signature dishes, Saloon Menu Board features, ingredient sourcing leads, bad review recovery requests, a Chef Token shop, perks, badges, kitchen upgrades, and a full Chef Journal.

Highlights

- Build a chef career from home cook to legendary cook.
- Master recipes, choose signature dishes, and improve dish ratings.
- Complete exact recipe orders, category orders, deliveries, mail requests, and weekly catering contracts.
- Host Friday Restaurant Nights with Gus at the Stardrop Saloon.
- Enter Sunday Cooking Competitions against themed rivals.
- Impress travelling food critics and collect recent reviews.
- Discover villager taste preferences and earn reputation around town.
- Spend Chef Tokens on perks, kitchen tools, rerolls, ingredient boosts, and one-time rewards.
